import re

RULE = re.compile(r"^=+(?: =+)*\s*$")
MSG = re.compile(r"^(?P<level>INFO|ERROR|WARNING):\s*(?P<text>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    blocks, skip, msgs, msg_lines = [], [], [], []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i]
        if RULE.match(ln) and i > 0 and lines[i - 1].strip():
            # the rule under the header gives the fixed column widths
            spans = [(m.start(), m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r"=+", ln)]
            last = len(spans) - 1
            hdr = lines[i - 1]
            names = [(hdr[a:] if k == last else hdr[a:b]).strip() or "col%d" % (k + 1)
                     for k, (a, b) in enumerate(spans)]
            used, recs = [i - 1], []
            skip.append(i)
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() and not RULE.match(lines[i]):
                row = lines[i]
                recs.append({names[k]: (row[a:] if k == last else row[a:b]).strip()
                             for k, (a, b) in enumerate(spans)})
                used.append(i)
                i += 1
            blocks.append({"name": "processes", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": recs})
            continue
        m = MSG.match(ln.strip())
        if m:
            msgs.append({"Level": m.group("level"), "Message": m.group("text")})
            msg_lines.append(i)
        i += 1
    if msgs:
        blocks.append({"name": "messages", "kind": "table", "lines": msg_lines, "records": msgs})
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
